what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Planned flush_review_batches test makes committed round directories part of the flush_review_batches surface
scenario_or_breakage: flush_review_batches writes tally and review-findings batches, while flush_round_log_after_coder writes round directories. Implementing the plan literally can push round-dir writing into flush_review_batches or create a failing test.
suggested_fix: Keep flush_review_batches focused on tally and findings. If the test must assert committed round dirs, seed them with existing flush_round_log_after_coder first; otherwise assert the tally against the seeded source round dirs only.
